identificationModule.briefTitle: The Efficacy of Primary Total Mesorectal Excision (TME) Surgery Versus Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Combined With TME Surgery in Low-risk Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: TME vs TME+nCT in Low-risk LARC

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Comparative analysis of the clinical efficacy between primary Total Mesorectal Excision (TME) surgery and neoadjuvant chemotherapy combined with TME surgery for low-risk locally advanced rectal cancer. Randomly enrolling eligible patients into either the control group receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy combined with TME surgery or the experimental group receiving primary TME surgery, and subsequently comparing the clinical outcomes of the two groups

designInfo.interventionModelDescription:
1. Primary TME
2. neoadjuvant chemotherapy plus TME

armGroups.label: Primary total mesorectal excision
armGroups.description: Patients with low-risk locally advanced rectal cancer received total mesorectal excision alone.

armGroups.label: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy plus TME
armGroups.description: Patients with low-risk locally advanced rectal cancer received neoadjuvant chemotherapy and total mesorectal excision.
interventionNames: Procedure: neoadjuvant chemotherapy plus total mesorectal excision

interventions.name: neoadjuvant chemotherapy plus total mesorectal excision
interventions.description: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy regimen recommended FOLFOX6, XELON, FOLFOX, mFOLFOX for 4-6 courses, and TME surgical treatment after preoperative tumor restaging 1-2 weeks after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

primaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the proportion of patients who did not experience any of the following events from the beginning of the randomized subgroup to the end of the third year, which included disease progression, local recurrence, distant metastasis, or second primary colorectal cancer, or death from any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Distance from the inferior resection margin to the tumor
secondaryOutcomes.description: The length between inferior resection margin and the tumor.
When the distance from the tumor or malignant lymph node to the circumferential margin was ≤ 1 mm, it was recorded as a positive circumferential margin.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The status of distal resection margin
secondaryOutcomes.description: When the distance from the tumor to the distal resection margin was ≤ 10 mm, it was recorded as a positive distal resection margin.
The days after surgery in the hospital
The duration after surgery to first feed
The duration after surgery to first gas
Postoperative pain according to pain socres
Anal function would be based on wexner Incontinence score. A total score of less than ten is considered good, and a score of more than ten is considered poor.
Quality of life score would be based on EORTC QoL C30 scale.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with treatment-related adverse events
secondaryOutcomes.description: It would be assessed by CTCAE v4.0
